title: Review of phase_membrane_damage_mature (L4a[L3]): repair Supported on fresh seeds 7 and 8 against same-seed undamaged twins; repair is by construction (curvature flow + tilt)
summary: Looked at the claim's seed2 damage.png, then re-ran phase_membrane on fresh seeds 7 and 8 with the claim's protocol (--frames 160 --damage 120:0.5:rim; measured losses 24.6% and 24.0%) and the same seeds without damage as branched twins (identical up to the cut). twin_compare.py follows the cut cell and the same cell in the twin. Seed 7: the bite closes by t=6250 (damage.png: round cell with a complete L ring), the damaged cell holds 0.92-0.95 of its twin's area from t=6200 to 7000 and stays one piece, while the twin divides at t~7500 (the damage delays division). Seed 8: the target was about to divide (the twin splits at frames 128-132 too), so 'mature, non-dividing' failed for that target; after the split the damaged lineage tracks the twin at 0.93-1.08 with ring contrast 1.56-1.9 vs 1.44-1.63 in the twin. One clean seed plus one confounded seed: repair holds, and it is automatic.

observations.S: rerun/seed7/sheet.png t=0: unstructured noise over the whole domain; walled cells by t=350
observations.I: rerun/seed7/sheet.png t=1100-8000: discrete walled cells persisting between divisions
observations.B: rerun/seed7/damage.png t=6250-8000: the repaired target carries a complete bright L ring at its wall; twin_compare_seed8.txt ring contrast 1.56-1.9
observations.R: rerun/seed7/damage.png and twin_compare_seed7.txt: a 25% rim cut closes by t=6250; area 0.92-0.95 of the same cell in the undamaged twin through t=7000

seeds_run.result: pass, but the target was about to divide (confounded)

controls_run.R: twin/seed7 and twin/seed8: same-seed undamaged runs, compared cell by cell in twin_compare_seed7.txt and twin_compare_seed8.txt

verdicts.limitation: Repair is curvature flow plus the link tilt, so it is automatic. labkit's mature-compact rule picked a cell about to divide on seed 8, and on seed 7 the damage delayed division, so 'mature' stays ill-defined in a continuously growing cell. The erased fraction was ~25% (rim mode), smaller than the claim's 41%.
